semantic_findings.finding: PhaseInput.check is an exact rational Boolean predicate. It checks every closed box endpoint against center plus or minus radius and checks exact rational phase enclosures at each center. PhaseInput.sound then uses the already checked whole-box trigonometric bound to enclose exp(I*x_i) for every real point x in the closed angle box. It assumes no native floating-point result.

phase_box_rejects_physical reaches the literal matrix target. Given Physical, Dephased, Maximal, strict 0 < leadingR, exact phase coordinates for the actual seed entries, a true PhaseInput check, and a true rejectsBoth check, it transfers the exact phase enclosures to the actual seed entries and applies the independently reviewed exact physical signed-mean rejection theorem.

The signed-mean consumer excludes both possible roots of the same actual physicalSideSign. Its plus and minus tests may use different matrix pairs; the proof does not introduce a false horizontal/vertical coupled-sign premise.

StrictMaximalPopulation contains a literal IsMUBQuartet witness whose actual phaseOverlap is Physical, Dephased, Maximal, has strict positive leadingR, and has exact PhaseCoordinates. phase_leaf_excluded unfolds that witness and applies the matrix rejection. checkedPhaseLeaf is the literal CertifiedTree.closed constructor, and its frontier is definitionally empty.

The leaf theorem is generic. It constructs one closed leaf only after receiving concrete proofs p.check b = true and rejectsBoth p.rectangles = true. The packet instantiates zero concrete PhaseInput values and zero concrete Boolean leaves, and supplies no split tree or complete forest.

quartet_reaches_strict_or_zero starts from literal Mub6.IsMUBQuartet, performs the independently reviewed maximal-corner selection and dephasing, and produces either a live strict point in the exact root or an actual quartet witness with leadingR = 0. The zero branch is retained and is not discarded by strict division.

noFour_of_strict_forest_and_zero is a sound conditional endpoint. It explicitly requires ZeroMaximalQuartetsExcluded, an actual CertifiedTree StrictMaximalPopulation (radianRoot 4), and an empty-frontier proof. None of these global data obligations is synthesized from a job status, receipt, or opaque assumption wrapper.
